Character creation puts its first four points on four separate skills. Gymnast +4 You jump and climb, and you keep doing it long after everyone else has stopped. Walls, cliffs, rooftops, rigging, open water, it's all just terrain that hasn't been crossed yet. You might be afraid of heights but that doesn't mean you can't get around quickly, whether that's threading a packed market at a dead sprint or crossing grassland ahead of raiders who know it better than you do. You never tire. You never stop. Never back down, never what? Body Rank 2 Gentle Giant +2 There’s strong and then there’s you. You’ve learned that sometimes the answer isn’t to pick the lock, it’s to remove the door. Perhaps even the best way through a door is to throw something heavy at it. Feats of raw power such as holding a door closed with a horde of zombies on the other side, lifting and moving objects of absurd weight, and even juggling your friends all fall within the wheelhouse of someone who treats boulders like a pebble.
